title: Linked List Operations (Code War Chain)
inputFormat:
Line 1: integer n (size)
Line 2: n space-separated integers
Line 3: L (0-based index)
Line 4: R (0-based index)
Line 5: K
Line 6: N
outputFormat: A single line output as described by the current stage.

stages.title: Stage 1 - Reverse List
stages.statement: Reverse the entire linked list and output the resulting values space-separated. Ignore L, R, K, N.

stages.title: Stage 2 - Reverse L to R
stages.statement: Reverse the sublist from 0-based index `L` to `R`. Output the result. Ignore K, N.

stages.title: Stage 3 - Reverse in K-Groups
stages.statement: Reverse the nodes of the list `K` at a time. If the number of nodes is not a multiple of `K`, leave the left-out nodes at the end as is. Ignore L, R, N.

stages.title: Stage 4 - Palindrome Check
stages.statement: Return `1` if the list is a palindrome, `0` otherwise. Ignore L, R, K, N.

stages.title: Stage 5 - Remove Nth from End
stages.statement: Remove the `N`-th node from the end of the list. Output the result. Ignore L, R, K.

stages.title: Stage 6 - Reorder List
stages.statement: Reorder the list to: L0 -> Ln-1 -> L1 -> Ln-2... Output the result. Ignore L, R, K, N.
